facts: Local destinations use page references and standard view arrays; destination byte-string identities are preserved.
Outline nodes use indirect parent/sibling/child links; Count magnitude reflects visible descendants and the sign reflects expansion.
Viewer PrintPageRange pairs use one-based page numbers.
The replacement transition style is R; 90/180 degree transition directions apply only to Wipe and 315 applies only to Glitter.
Fly SS describes starting/ending scale; None is the nondirectional Fly name.
Alphabetic labels repeat each letter: A..Z, AA..ZZ, AAA..ZZZ; lowercase follows the same rule.
limitations: The primary specification does not establish source behavior or production conformance.
PDF 2.0 Enforce requires separate complete final-profile conformance evidence.
